name: Economics (PMn)

rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc:
• The minimum university requirement for a PhD minor is 20 units of coursework at the graduate level (courses numbered 201 and above) at Stanford.

• Units taken for the minor can be counted as part of the overall requirement for the PhD of 135 units done at Stanford.

• Courses used for a minor may not be used to meet requirements for a master’s degree.

• To be recommended for the PhD degree as a minor subject in Economics, a student must qualify in three fields of economics.

• At least one of which must be in the core economics sequence (microeconomics, macroeconomics, or econometrics).

• Two other field sequences must be completed toward the minor if only taking one of the core sequences. The standard of achievement in these fields is the same for minor as for major candidates - typically two courses per field (often with a paper requirement) and passing the exams in the core field(s).

• A list of fields, field requirements, and courses that satisfy the field requirements can be found in Graduate Degree Program Requirements.

• The major and minor departments must approve a PhD minor form outlining the program of study.

rules.name: One core sequence plus two fields, or all three core sequences

children.name: Path 1: one core sequence and two fields
Graduate Core
children.desc: Complete all three classes in either micro, macro, or metrics to fulfill the sequence. To pass a sequence, an overall grade of B is required, and individual course grades must be 'B-' or better.

children.name: Field Requirement
children.desc: Specifics about each year's field requirement updates can be found on the Economics department website.

children.name: Econometrics
children.notes: Students are encouraged to additionally take at least one of the following: MGTECON 614, MGTECON 661, MS&E 328, 300+ level courses in Statistics or Computer Science, approved by faculty

children.name: History/Institutions
children.desc: Grades of B+ or higher are required.

rules.desc: Complete all three classes in either micro, macro, or metrics to fulfill the sequence. To pass a sequence, an overall grade of B is required, and individual course grades must be ‘B-’ or better.

rules.name: GPA of 3.0, and B or better expected in PhD-level courses
Overall B in each core sequence and the core field exams
PhD minor form approved by both departments

gpa: All graduate students should have an average grade point average of 3.0, which is the equivalent of a B average.
grading: Students in the Department of Economics are expected to earn a minimum of a B in all PhD-level coursework unless otherwise stated.
transferPolicy: Per policy (GAP 4.5.1 Doctoral Degrees, Requirements), all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: You choose one of two paths: one graduate core sequence (micro, macro or metrics) plus two fields, or all nine core courses. Each core course needs a B- or better, History/Institutions courses need a B+ or better, and the audit checks the 20-unit minimum. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, the overall B in each core sequence, the core field exams and the PhD minor form signed by both departments.
